resolveModelProviderFailed: Could not resolve model provider. Open the model list and pick an entry (provider in parentheses).
hubHomeSubtitle: Pick a dashboard from the sidebar or create a new one.
photosDragHint: Drag cards to reorder. Click a photo to enlarge.
uploadNoRef: Upload succeeded but no file reference was returned.
photosEmptyReadOnly: No photos in this section yet.
photosEmptyEditable: Add entries — upload an image (save dashboard) or paste an external URL.
embedUrlNotAllowed: URL not allowed or invalid. Allowed hosts:
embedGoogleCalendarHint: Google Calendar: Calendar → Settings → Integrate calendar → copy the embed URL (https://calendar.google.com/…).
embedUnavailableReadOnly: Embed not available (invalid or non-allowlisted URL).
embedEmptyEditable: Enter an HTTPS URL of an allowlisted service (e.g. Google Calendar).
kanbanEmptyHint: Add a column to get started.
workspaceNotFound: Workspace id not found in your account.
workspaceRequiredForRun: Link or create a workspace before queuing a run.
importFromGithubHint: Select repositories to add to this portfolio. Optionally clone them as coding workspaces.
importGithubTokenHint: Add your personal GitHub token under Settings → Connections (github_pat). Each user uses their own token.
onboardingGenericStarter: Help me set up this dashboard. {{greeting}}
overviewEmpty: No dashboards yet. Create one from the sidebar.
overviewSubtitle: Everything you can open in this tenant — yours and shared — grouped by hub.
mediaQueueEmpty: Queue is empty — upload a track or add a YouTube/Vimeo embed.
mediaSharePanelHint: Only your own uploads can be shared. Set a license first, then invite a user in your tenant by email.
mediaShareNoUploads: No uploads in your library yet.
mediaPlayingInFooter: Playing in the footer bar — you can switch pages while audio continues.
mediaMiniPlayerEmbedHint: Embed — video plays on the dashboard
sectionEmpty: No blocks in this section yet.
sectionUnavailable: Section layout unavailable in this view.
cardGridEmpty: No items yet — add rows to the data source or import repos.
catalogIntro: Install packs to enable storage. Nothing is created until you add dashboards afterward.
installPackConfirmBody: Applies schema for this pack. You still create dashboard rows separately.
gridMobileStackHint: Blocks are stacked full width on small screens. Layout editing is available from tablet size upward.
embeddedChatTeamHint: Team dashboard chat when available (read-only for your role). If the owner has not created a shared thread yet, this panel may be empty.
embeddedChatPrivateHint: Private assistant: your first message creates the thread (no empty placeholder in main Chat). Text + images like main Chat.
embeddedChatNoVisibleYet: No dashboard chat visible for your role yet. Viewers need a shared team conversation (created with shared: true on the API) to see the same thread as others.
embeddedChatEmptyWithThread: Ask questions or attach images (+) — same multimodal messages as the main Chat page.
embeddedChatEmptyNoThread: No conversation yet — send below to create your private thread (first message is stored).
embeddedChatSlowHint: Still working — large layout proposals can take a few minutes on local models.
embeddedChatComposerHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for new line
embeddedChatNewThreadHint: Start another private assistant thread for this dashboard. Switch threads in the list above.
pickFileHint: Pick a file in the tree (read-only preview).
selectChangedFileHint: Select a changed file to view its diff.
heroEmptyEditable: Hero image: enter a URL or upload (save dashboard first).
heroSaveBeforeUploadHint: Save the dashboard first, then upload.
timelineEmptyEditable: Events with dates — sorted chronologically (oldest first).
agentPromptExtraPlaceholder: e.g. You help with pet care; prefer pets_* tools with this dashboard_id …
agentPromptScrollHint: ↓ Below (separate card): Tool preferences — scroll down on small screens.
newDashboardSubtitle: Create a dashboard from an installed template.
installPackFromCatalogFirst: Install a pack from the Catalog first.
saveInMainToolbarHint: Save using the main toolbar Save button.
dashboardAgentIntro: Extra instructions for the model when this dashboard is active (embedded chat and any chat with agent_dashboard_context). Appended server-side to system context — e.g. tone, tools, or domain.
dashboardToolPrefsIntro: If you list tools here, the agent on this dashboard only sees these function names (after router, operator policies, and your global tool disables). Empty = no extra restriction. Applies to embedded chat and chats with agent_dashboard_context.
dashboardToolCatalogErr: Could not load tool catalog ({{err}}). You can enter names manually.
dashboardToolEditorOnly: Only editors/owners can change the allowlist.
membersIntro: Same-tenant accounts only. Viewer is read-only. Editor can edit content. Co-owner can edit and manage members. Only the primary owner can delete the dashboard.
membersManagePermissionDenied: You don’t have permission to manage members.
membersMovedHint: Sharing & members are now in Settings.
blockSharingIntroBody: “Sharing & members” above — co-owner, editor, and viewer roles stay as they are. Use this for someone who is not a full member: View only shows selected blocks read-only; Edit lets them change content (and those blocks in the layout) only. Same tenant only; saving again updates that user's block list and access.
blockSharingListHint: Shared boards appear as their own entry in the sidebar — not embedded in Personal unless you pin a block or import a layout.
templateImportHint: Create a new dashboard from a JSON template file (copy, not live sync).
pinBlockHint: Pin as live link on another dashboard
pinBlockToChatHint: Pin this block to the assistant — say e.g. “change this block to …”
blockSettingsIntroAutoSave: Changes are saved to this dashboard immediately.
blockSettingsIntroDraft: Changes apply to the layout draft — click Save to persist.
blockSettingsPreviewMissing: No data at this path yet.
blockSettingsDataPathHint: Key in dashboard data JSON (e.g. projects, items).
blockSettingsFillGridHint: Content grows with the block when you resize the layout (less inner scrolling).
refMissingSource: Missing source dashboard or block id.
shareWidgetNoFriend: Configure friend user id in block props.
shareWidgetUnsupported: Resource type {{type}} not supported in widget yet.
viewerReadOnlyGranular: Read-only: you only see blocks the owner shared with you. Shared dashboard team chat is not included on this access level.
viewerReadOnlySimple: Read-only: you can view lists and photos here. Ask the owner for editor access if you should change something.
noBlocksInLayoutYet: No blocks in the layout yet — add blocks on the canvas first.
publicShareIntro: Read-only link for people without an AgentLayer account. No blocks selected = entire dashboard; otherwise only checked blocks (e.g. dog photo albums). The URL is shown only once when created — revoke and create a new link to rotate.
publicShareCreatedOnce: New link — copy now (not shown again):
publicShareMissingToken: No share token in the URL (?t=…).
publicSharePasswordTooShort: Password must be at least 4 characters.
layoutProposalsSubtitle: Full-size preview — apply here or close and use the cards in chat.
layoutProposalsEmpty: No proposals in this set (it may have expired).
